developers.text: Source, target, and executor registries support file and database imports; database executors validate a previewed schema and track source keys for repeat imports.

troubleshooting.symptom: A package upload fails in the admin before the import review opens
troubleshooting.cause: Livewire checks every temporary upload against `livewire.temporary_file_upload.rules`, whose default limit (12 MB) is lower than the package limit
troubleshooting.check: Compare the package size with the `max:` rule in `config/livewire.php` and with `migration-assistant.limits.max_package_upload_kilobytes`
troubleshooting.fix: Publish the Livewire config and raise the `max:` value in `temporary_file_upload.rules` to at least the package limit, or import the file with `php artisan migration-assistant:import`

troubleshooting.symptom: `migration-assistant:import --execute` or `--sync` stops before creating a session
troubleshooting.cause: An import that writes pages runs as a named user, and no `--actor` was given or that user cannot import pages
troubleshooting.check: Read the error the command printed
troubleshooting.fix: Run the command again with `--actor=<user id>` for a user who holds the page import permission
